description: Angular component for a two-segment toggle button widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling initialization, state changes, and user interactions.

classes.name: TwoSegmentButtonWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicActionWidgetComponent, implementing a two-segment toggle button with configurable appearance and state management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, state getters, and appearance.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook after view initialization, calls superclass method.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for cleanup, calls superclass method.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Additional initialization, sets overlay style based on widget element.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Handles updates to the toggle value, updates appearance and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Handles updates to the disabled state, triggers change detection.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user click events, triggers corresponding widget actions based on toggle state.
